[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-1i4[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Agent scopes reap every process an agent leaks[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]No process an agent starts outlives its agent runner unless SASE [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]deliberately escaped it into its own systemd scope. Leftovers die [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]when the runner exits (and between in-process successor turns), and[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a five-minute backstop reaps sase-agent scopes whose runner died [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]without cleaning up, while shared user daemons (ssh-agent, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]gpg-agent, ssh ControlMaster, tmux server) are never killed.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Escape long-lived SASE helpers from the agent scope[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]escape-helpers[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]escape-helpers: route the four fire-and-forget spawns reachable from an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]agent (background trash delete, goals fetch worker, federation worker [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]daemon, tmux session bootstrap) through detach_scope so the new sweep [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]can never kill them, with detach-scope worker tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Agent runner sweeps its own scope[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]runner-teardown[dim] · [dim][/dim]after escape-helpers[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]runner-teardown: add the shared scope-sweep module, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]agent_scope_teardown config block, and the runner hooks that kill [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]non-descendant, non-spared processes in the runner's own sase-agent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]scope before shutdown finalization and between in-process successor [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]turns.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Orphaned agent scope reaper job[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]scope-reaper[dim] · [dim][/dim]after runner-teardown[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]scope-reaper: add a checks-routine job that discovers sase-agent scopes [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with no live runner and sweeps their non-spared processes, with a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dry-run core API, docs, and a live systemd test.[/#D7D7AF]
